prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape LORE fantasy card-game key visual synthesizing the supplied four artworks, with the real LORE wordmark as the fifth reference. This is a new unified scene, NOT a collage.

REFERENCE ROLES AND PRIORITIES:
Image 1 (night-blue vast archive): primary atmosphere reference. Take the rich midnight-navy negative space, crystalline cyan magic, silver-white lit architecture, sense of mystical scale and beautiful depth. Simplify its ornamentation and number of objects substantially. Do NOT use its lone standing figure.
Image 2 (white bridge and book carriage): supporting world reference. Borrow one elegant white interior gallery bridge with a small physical book circulation trolley as a quiet secondary detail.
Image 3 (circular sealed door): supporting architecture reference. Borrow one clean monumental circular eye/compass archive seal behind the focal scene.
Image 4 (two seated readers): MAIN COMPOSITION and CHARACTER reference. Preserve the two identifiable young ADULT male scholars, silver hair with red-lined ivory cloak on the left, dark hair with blue-lined ivory cloak on the right, seated OPPOSITE each other across the SAME round reading table, clearly meeting each other's gaze. Preserve their thoughtful duel atmosphere and elegant anime character rendering. Do not put them side-by-side and do not turn them into standing wizards.
Image 5 (actual LORE wordmark): authoritative BRAND style reference and small title reference. Its crisp angular white/silver facets, near-black/navy recesses, bright cyan edge and eye-with-compass ring must govern the WHOLE image's shape language. The user wants the environment closer to the logo's atmosphere, not simply more eye decals.

SCENE AND VISUAL HIERARCHY:
A ceremonial magical reading duel (対読) in the Grand Archive of All Histories (万史大書庫).
Foreground/lower-middle: the two seated opposing scholars and a generous round ivory-white table form ONE immediately readable, complete focal group. Cinematic eye-level view, modestly pulled back compared with image 4 so we see the surrounding magical library, but both faces, opposing poses, hands and tabletop remain legible. Figures and table occupy roughly the central 65% width and lower 50-55% height. Keep heads fully visible and give the chairs and table physically plausible geometry.
One open chronicle at center, a few clearly separated physical illustrated cards on EACH player's side (no readable microtext or UI frames), and a small faceted blue Attune crystal. Show the left scholar thoughtfully advancing ONE card with one hand while the right scholar studies him and holds a small fan of three cards; natural anatomically correct hands, no duplicate limbs. Two subtle reading lamps. One crisp red bookmark. Restrained cyan light rises from the open chronicle into a SMALL luminous suggestion of reconstructed history, not a giant busy hologram.
Background: a single clean round silver-white archive doorway with an abstract cyan eye/diamond in its center, set amid two or three simple tiers of library shelves with dark navy recesses. One elegant narrow white bridge is visible to a side; one small white-and-dark-blue book circulation trolley sits there. No other people. No repeated eye symbols everywhere. A few suspended pages at most.
The upper third has calm deep-blue vaulted shadow and generous breathing room. White pillars and white books lit by clear cool light define the space; dramatic depth without black crushed detail.

COLOR AND STYLE:
Premium Genshin-like anime-fantasy promotional illustration, painterly environmental depth and clean controlled character shapes, original LORE identity. White remains the dominant MATERIAL of architecture, table and clothing. Restore substantial deep navy/near-black shadow around the bright white focal group, as in image 1 and the logo: approximate visible masses 50-55% silver/ivory white, 30-35% rich midnight navy, 10% blue/cyan light, 5% crimson accents. Do not return to an all-white sunwashed palace. Do not make it entirely dark. Strong crisp white/navy contrast, crystalline cyan glow with controlled bloom. Red only on the left cloak lining, bookmark and a few small book bindings. Metal accents primarily silver and blackened silver, extremely little gold. Polished calm planes, angular chamfers and a few circular structures echo the logo. Avoid generic gold-trimmed rococo cathedral styling.
Simpler than reference 1: no busy floating city, no animal constellations, no enormous layered orrery, no countless flying books or tangled stairs. Retain enchanting fantasy and sophistication rather than stripping the environment bare.
Lighting: silver-blue illumination on white surfaces, quiet navy overhead, cyan reflected light from the book on the scholars, very restrained warm neutral reading-lamp glow. Not daylight sky outside.

BRANDING:
Include one tasteful small exact-looking LORE wordmark matching image 5 at bottom center, about 18% width, on a quiet dark navy foreground margin without obscuring the characters, table or hands. Preserve L O R E readability, distinctive eye inside O, original letter silhouettes and white/cyan finish. No other text, subtitle, watermarks, UI, borders or stats.

Deliver one coherent polished KEY VISUAL. The emotional read is: two equal rivals quietly dueling through recorded histories in an immense, mysterious white-and-blue magical library. The opposing seated duel is the focal point; architecture supports it.
